fields.what_it_is: Revere Hybrid Access Catheter is a single lumen, hybrid coil and braid-reinforced, variable stiffness catheter with a radiopaque zone on the distal end and a luer hub on the proximal end. The catheter is provided sterile, non-pyrogenic, and is intended for single use only.
fields.use_notes: MRI: Labeling does not contain MRI Safety Information. Pre-sterilized. Single-use
